Base directory for this skill: /home/dev/.claude/skills/council

# Council

Before an audit, address outstanding PR comments, fix known issues, and run
relevant checks. Give council the updated implementation; do not defer known
fixes until reviews return. If the user wants to discard the implementation
and explore new ideas, skip fixes to code being replaced.

Bring in three delegates to help with the user's request, usually for review
or feedback. Use one strong model from each of three different providers, at
high reasoning effort. If the user's instructions name council members, use
those. Otherwise pick the latest flagship model from each provider, for
example Claude Opus, GPT Sol, and Gemini Pro.

In T3 Code, use `orchestrator_capabilities` to resolve the models, then
`delegate_task` to start one delegate per model in parallel. Elsewhere, use
the harness's subagent tools. If you cannot reach three providers, or a named
member is unavailable, report it instead of substituting.

Give each delegate the request and relevant context. For review or feedback,
keep their work read-only. Collect their responses and summarize the useful
findings, disagreements, and recommended next steps.

Do not wait idle. When a result arrives, check its findings against the code
at once and decide what to fix while the other delegates run. Do not edit
files while a delegate still reviews the same checkout. If the user's
instructions mark a delegate as non-blocking, do not wait for it; treat a
late result as feedback and do not record its score.

For a code review, ask each delegate for a score out of 10.
Count each full review pass as one round.
A fresh review after fixes starts a new round.

If the work ends in a pull request, put the results in the PR description.
Put this section before the model and harness line at the end:

```markdown
## Council review

Rounds: 2

| Delegate | Round 1 | Round 2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Opus | 7/10 | 9/10 |
| GPT Sol | 8/10 | 10/10 |
| Gemini Pro | 7/10 | 9/10 |
```

If a delegate gives no score, write `no score`. Do not invent one.
If the PR is open, edit the description. Do not post a comment for this.
If there is no PR, put the same results in the final reply only.

If you agree with their recommendations, make the changes and request a fresh
review after. Continue this process until all delegates are satisfied with the
outcome.

Do not let repeated reviews result in scope creep. It is your job to fight to
keep scope limited.


ARGUMENTS: Fix the image comparison modal UI (Trackdown web app, "Edited copy" / IMAGE COMPARISON dialog) to match the rest of the website. description: Council skill's third seat is GPT-6 Astra (high) because no third provider (Muse/Gemini) is enabled
metadata:

---

The council skill needs three providers, but only Claude and Codex are enabled in T3 Code here (Muse Code, Antigravity/Gemini and Grok are disabled). name: shared-checkout-fetch-blocked
description: "git fetch in the shared /srv checkout can fail on other users' mode-600 Entire objects; work in an own clone"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 251074f4-ce2c-41f9-89d3-9ae190692545
  modified: 2026-11-14T07:36:13.709Z
---

On 2026-11-14, `git fetch` in /srv/junction-espoo/gemini-4-braincells failed ("unable to open loose object ... Permission denied", bad object refs/entire/checkpoints/...) because the Entire CLI wrote checkpoint objects owned by teammates (e.g. temuulen) with mode 600. dev's own timer (fix-shared-git-perms) only fixes dev's files; other users' files need their owner or sudo.

**Why:** Entire writes checkpoint files with a fixed 0600 that umask and core.sharedRepository can't override.
**How to apply:** for branch/PR work, clone fresh into ~/work/<name> (owned by dev) instead of fixing others' files. Commits there carry no Entire-Checkpoint trailer because the clone has no Entire hooks; mention that in the report.

Also seen 2026-11-14: a T3 worktree's admin dir (`/srv/.../.git/worktrees/<name>`) vanished mid-session (likely a `git worktree prune` by someone), so `git` failed in it while files stayed intact. Fix without touching files: clone into ~/work/<name>, `git worktree add --no-checkout -b <branch> <tmp> <base>`, copy `<tmp>/.git` over the T3 dir's `.git`, `git worktree repair <T3 dir>`, delete `<tmp>`, then `git reset` (mixed) to rebuild the index. See [[shared-git-push-workaround]].

name: shared-worktrees-pruned
description: Worktree registrations of the shared /srv gemini-4-braincells .git can vanish mid-task; git in those worktrees then fails
metadata:
  type: project
---

On 2026-11-14 ~08:56 Espoo, every worktree's admin dir under /srv/junction-espoo/gemini-4-braincells/.git/worktrees/ for T3 and scratchpad worktrees was removed (someone ran a prune/cleanup), so `git` in ~/.t3/worktrees/gemini-4-braincells/* failed with "not a git repository". Files on disk were intact.

**Why:** shared .git used by several seats and agents; cleanups by others hit everyone's worktrees.

**How to apply:** for multi-hour branch/PR work, prefer a fresh clone in ~/work/<name> from the start; if a worktree breaks, don't repair the shared .git: diff your files against the start commit and apply only your diff in a clone (main may have moved). Related: [[shared-checkout-fetch-blocked]], [[shared-git-push-workaround]].

name: ui-screenshot-pipeline
description: How to screenshot the Noise Radar web UI with live prod data for council/design reviews (no browser MCP needed)
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: 20089a70-c986-44b3-85ee-96de57953d15
  modified: 2026-11-14T05:58:46.838Z
---

No system Playwright install, but browsers are cached in `~/.cache/ms-playwright` (chromium-1194/1248). Working recipe (2026-11-14, PR #39):

- Tiny stdlib Python proxy serving the clone's `web/public` on a port in dev's block (3000-3009) and forwarding `/api/*` to https://noise-radar.srv2159172.hstgr.cloud, so local UI edits render with live prod data. An env switch can serve `/api/metrics` from a fixture file (prod `eval_runs` was empty).
- Screenshots: `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=~/.cache/ms-playwright uv run -q --with playwright==1.56.0 python shoot.py`, at 1440x900 and 390x844. Cut full-page shots into ~1400 px parts with pillow so reviewers can read them.
- Full-page captures draw `position:fixed` bars mid-page. Tell reviewers it's an artifact.
- Check `document.documentElement.scrollWidth == 390` per route to catch horizontal overflow.

Related: [[council-third-seat-astra]], [[shared-git-push-workaround]].

Trackdown dev server (2026-11-14): `npx vite --port N` binds only [::1], so use http://localhost:N, not 127.0.0.1. Give each delegate its own port: Sol reviewers start their own vite, and a busy --strictPort fails quietly in the log while the old server keeps answering. Kill servers by PID from `ss -ltnp`; `pkill -f vite` (or `pgrep -af vite | xargs kill`) also matches the calling shell and kills the command (exit 144).

name: work-clone-no-checkpoint-trailers
description: "Commits made in ~/work clones (by Claude or Codex delegates) got no Entire-Checkpoint trailer, so squash-merge bodies come out empty"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 713144a0-5dae-41bc-864e-8327a742ac53
  modified: 2026-11-14T12:13:01.067Z
---

On 2026-11-14 (PR #76, meme-variants) none of the 6 commits made in the fresh clone `~/work/meme-variants` carried an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, even though `.git/hooks` had Entire's commit-msg/prepare-commit-msg hooks and `entire status` showed it enabled. The AGENTS.md squash command then produced an empty body, so main has no link to the agent sessions.

**Why:** unknown; likely the hooks don't see an active session for commits made from a clone outside the T3 session's cwd (/srv checkout), or from Codex delegates.
**Fix that worked (2026-11-14, PR #87 meme-imagediff):** with the user's OK, run `entire session attach <this session id> --force </dev/null` on the unpushed HEAD before each push. It adds the trailer and a checkpoint covering the turns since the last one. The squash body then had 5 trailers. Without `--force` it only prints what it would do (a dry run). See [[shared-git-push-workaround]].

**How to apply:** say so in reports when working from ~/work clones ([[shared-checkout-fetch-blocked]], [[shared-worktrees-pruned]]). Don't run `entire enable`/setup to "fix" it without asking the user.

# Council review, round 1: Trackdown meme comparison dialog restyle

## The user's request
"Fix this UI to match the rest of the website. Currently disgusting and doesn't fit 'renaissance' at all."
Their screenshot of the old dialog: /home/dev/.t3/userdata/attachments/ce1be418-dfca-4106-ac63-8f790533a298-3ad042b6-7a6f-41d7-a0a9-5f6253d1fd1e.png

Trackdown ("Shill or Chill") is a hackathon web app: a Renaissance painting (Botticelli's Birth of Venus) read by
machine vision. Its design language is in `web/trackdown/src/styles.css` (tokens at the top: near-black
surfaces, white-alpha hairlines, warm off-white text, painting colours for meaning (`--origin` gold,
`--mutation` orange, `--shill` rose, `--chill` sea), `--cv` green only for detection boxes, Michroma
`--wide` letterspaced words, JetBrains Mono uppercase labels, cut-corner modal `.modal`, underlined `.tabs`,
`.stats` grid, dashed `.notice`).

The meme trace feature (`web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css`, `compare.ts`, `variations.ts`) had been built with
its own mint-green terminal palette (#a2ffb5, #101411, greenish greys) that matched nothing else.

## What changed (uncommitted, in the checkout below)
- Checkout: `/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance` (branch ui/compare-renaissance, base origin/main 825239f).
  Diff: `/tmp/claude-1001/-srv-junction-espoo-gemini-4-braincells/164d76fc-e50c-47dd-9796-d6d686e923bf/scratchpad/r1.diff`
- `meme.css` rewritten onto the site tokens: dialog = site modal (cut corners, hairline border, pop
  animation), Michroma title with a 2px underline in the relation colour (`data-relation` on the dialog),
  layout switch styled as the panel tabs, plane headers as mono labels, detection boxes = the canvas
  `.cvbox` look, facts as a `.stats`-like grid, "what changed" as the panel's `.change` rows, kind chips
  as `.vchip`, honesty line as a dashed gold `.notice`. Panel section and canvas cards moved to tokens too.
- `compare.ts`: facts markup became label/value cells; close button uses the site's close icon; `//`
  eyebrows dropped (also in `variations.ts`).

## Screenshots
Before: `.../scratchpad/before/` (desktop-site.png is the main page with the meme panel; ref-static.png and
ref-newtrace.png are other site views for reference). After: `.../scratchpad/r0/`
(desktop-compare-edited(.png|-bottom.png), desktop-compare-cropped*, desktop-compare-overlay.png,
phone-*). Scratchpad = `/tmp/claude-1001/-srv-junction-espoo-gemini-4-braincells/164d76fc-e50c-47dd-9796-d6d686e923bf/scratchpad`.
Edited shots swap the mock SVG for the Venus painting so a real photo shows.

To render it yourself: `cd /home/dev/work/compare-renaissance/web/trackdown && npx vite --port <YOUR_PORT> --strictPort`
(node_modules are installed; vite binds [::1], so use http://localhost:PORT), then
`cd <scratchpad> && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=~/.cache/ms-playwright uv run -q --with playwright==1.56.0 python shoot.py <your-out-dir> <YOUR_PORT>`.
Use your own out dir under /tmp. Kill your vite by PID (from `ss -ltnp`) when done; do not `pkill -f vite`.

## Your job (read-only: do NOT edit files in the checkout)
Review whether the dialog now fits the rest of the site and the Renaissance theme, and whether anything
broke (overlay slider, unavailable-image fallback, phone layout, focus/keyboard, live refresh, contrast).
Keep to this dialog and its stylesheet; don't propose redesigning other parts of the site or the feature's
behaviour. Give concrete, minimal fixes (selector + property) ranked by impact, and a score out of 10 for
how well it now matches the site. Be brief.

content:
Delegated task node:delegated-task:command%3Amcp%3Aea27cbf7-6589-44d8-a0a0-cdebb5c2f4bb%3Adelegate-task%3A6421678d-69ae-42f9-aa46-9a7cdbd892b3 (Council r1: Opus) [completed]:
Verdict: the dialog now fits the site well, but the restyle broke one thing. In Slider overlay mode the "Match · domain" label is now almost invisible. Score: **8/10** for how well it matches the site; about 8.5 once fix 1 is in.

I worked from the diff, the tokens in `styles.css` and the r0/before screenshots, and didn't start vite. The checkout is untouched.

## What works
- **Site tokens:** the restyle uses only real site tokens; I checked every `var(--…)` and `@keyframes pop` against `styles.css`.
- **Modal look:** the dialog is now the site's `.modal`: same cut corners, hairline border and pop animation.
- **Title:** Michroma plus the relation-coloured underline is the best part. The orange for "Edited" also carries into the relation fact, the ↺ markers and the chips, so the painting colours mean something.
- **Matching parts:** the tabs, `.stats` grid, `.change` rows, `.vchip` chips, dashed gold notice and `.cvbox` detection boxes all match their site versions.
- **Gone:** the mint-green terminal palette and the `//` eyebrows.
- **Live refresh:** it updates `data-relation`.
- **Focus:** the ring on the close button in the r0 shots is correct. `shoot.py` pressed Escape first, so the browser is in keyboard mode.

## Fixes, most important first
1. **Overlay match label hidden (regression; visible in `r0/desktop-compare-overlay.png` and `phone-compare-edited.png`).** The base `.meme-plane h3` now has `left:0; right:0`, so the Submission header bar stretches across the full width. In overlay mode the variant plane's `clip-path` makes it its own layer, so the Submission header (z-index 2, 90% opaque background) draws over the variant's label, which has had its background removed. The old CSS kept that header to the right side only (`left:auto`).
   Fix:
   - add `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay] .meme-variant { z-index: 3; }`
   - delete `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay] .meme-variant h3 { background: none; border-bottom: 0; }`

   The slider line also has z-index 3 and comes later in the page, so it stays on top.
2. **Phone close button is smaller.** It went from at least 44px to 36px, below the touch-target size. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-close { width: 44px; height: 44px; } }`
3. **Phone: pictures start right under the orange rule.** The layout tabs are hidden on phones and the body has only 4px top padding. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-compare-body { padding-top: 16px; } }`
4. **"No longer a match" keeps the old colour.** `showRemoved` doesn't change `data-relation`, so the removed state still shows the orange "edited" underline. Fix: `.meme-compare[data-removed] { --vc: var(--unsure); }`
5. **Phone facts grid with no source page.** "First seen" (`.wide`, spanning 2 columns) is then the 6th cell. It wraps to column 1 but still gets the left border and padding meant for column 2. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-fact.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; } }`
6. **Cosmetic:** `#c9c4bb` for same/resized is the only colour that isn't a token. Use `var(--text-2)` or `var(--relay)`.

## Checked and fine
- **Missing-image fallback:** its rules are unchanged, apart from the font.
- **Text contrast:** grey labels (about 5.9:1) and orange (about 6:1) on the dialog background are fine. The only contrast failure is the label in fix 1.
- **Reduced motion:** the site's global reduced-motion rule covers the new pop animation.
- **Keyboard:** the `swap`/`setPicture` code that keeps focus after a refresh is unchanged.

**Site match: 8.5/10.** The warm neutrals, painting-derived accents, Michroma headings, tabs, and stat grid now fit the existing Renaissance/machine-vision design well.

- **P2 — Overlay match heading is nearly invisible.** The full-width submission heading (`z-index: 2`) paints over the clipped variant’s stacking context. Reproduced on mobile; not a text-colour issue. Add `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay] .meme-plane { isolation: isolate; }`—verified in-browser to correct stacking. [meme.css:78](/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance/web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:78)
- **P3 — Mobile close target shrank from 44px to 36px.** Restore `.meme-close { width: 44px; height: 44px; }` inside the phone media query for easier tapping. [meme.css:64](/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance/web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:64)
- **P3 — Missing source URL misaligns the mobile “First seen” row.** It becomes the sixth cell and inherits a left divider/inset despite spanning the entire row. After the mobile `nth-child` rules, add `.meme-fact.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }`. [meme.css:138](/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance/web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:138)

**Verified:** slider keyboard control, unavailable-image fallback, 320/390px layouts, focus wrapping, Escape/focus restoration, live refresh retaining slider/focus, and removed-match state. TypeScript, 29 meme checks, and 11 tests pass. Checkout unchanged; review server stopped.

content.thinking:
I'm going over the overlay stacking fix: isolation on the overlay planes should keep the upload heading's z-index contained. The variant plane comes later in the DOM and creates its own stacking context through clip-path, so it should sit on top, which works. I'm also weighing whether to restore the variant heading's background, since Opus suggested removing the bg:none rule.

I'm weighing whether the variant heading should keep its background none or drop that override, so its bar lines up with the upload header's bar at the seam. Separately, I'm going through the phone fixes: close button at 44px, body padding-top 16, the removed --vc variable, and the full-width row on phone. On the grey colour, the copy finding uses the same value on purpose, so I'm leaving it alone.

content.text: All three reviewers agree on the slider-label fix. I'm applying it along with the close button, phone spacing, removed-state colour and facts-grid fixes. I'm leaving the `#c9c4bb` colour as is: it's the same colour the panel already uses for a "Copy" finding.

Delegated task node:delegated-task:command%3Amcp%3Aea27cbf7-6589-44d8-a0a0-cdebb5c2f4bb%3Adelegate-task%3A78dc2587-784d-4b3f-8d28-66939956d760 (Council r2: Opus) [completed]:
The dialog now matches the site. Every round-1 fix holds, and I found two small leftovers. **Score: 8.5/10.**

**Round-1 fixes, all confirmed**
1. In overlay mode both plane headers form one bar, and "Match · caption.example" shows on the left on desktop. On a phone it gets cut off at the slider position, which is what the reveal is meant to do.
2. The close button is 44px on phone and 36px on desktop.
3. On phone with no source page, "First seen" spans the full width and lines up.
4. On phone, the pictures have space below the orange rule.
5. "No longer a match" has the grey `--unsure` underline. Its title stays readable.
6. Keeping `#c9c4bb` is right. A live change from edited to same switches the underline and relation colour to it.

**What I checked myself** (my own renders on port 3007, desktop 1440 and phone 390):
- **Fit:** the dialog uses the site's modal look: cut corners, hairline border, pop animation, Michroma title, tab-style layout switch, stat grid, `.change` rows, `.vchip` chips and the dashed gold notice. Green only appears on the detection boxes. Nothing from the old mint palette is left.
- **Live refresh:** "removed" and "relabelled to same" both update correctly, with no page errors.
- **Keyboard:** Tab cycles inside the dialog (layout buttons → source link → close), and Escape closes it. On phone the layout buttons are hidden and the slider takes their place in the order.
- **Contrast:** the faintest text (`--text-3` on `--ink-bg`) is about 5.9:1, which is fine.

**Still worth changing (both in meme.css, highest impact first)**
1. **The missing-image box breaks the frame.** In overlay mode, or on a phone, when the match image fails or there is none, the plane is 160px tall. The fallback box (130px minimum plus the 34px header) is taller than that, so its black background covers part of the plane's bottom border. It shows as a black notch, both on desktop with a broken image and on phone with no image.
   - Fix: `.meme-image[data-unavailable] { background: none; }`. Alternatively, raise the 160px plane to 170px.
2. **"Submission" is right-aligned when the two planes stack.** The `.meme-upload h3 { justify-content: flex-end }` rule still applies when overlay falls back to stacking, so "Submission" sits on the right while "Match" sits on the left.
   - Fix: add `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay]:has([data-unavailable]) .meme-upload h3 { justify-content: flex-start; }`.
3. **The "removed" message is faint (optional).** It is now the dialog's only content, but it uses the small 12px grey note style.
   - Fix: `.meme-compare[data-removed] .meme-note { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); }`.

Point 2 already happened before this change; it just shows more clearly now.

**Housekeeping:** I didn't edit any files. An untracked `.vite/` folder appeared at the checkout root at 14:33, during my vite run. It is a cache folder that is not tracked and is probably mine, but I left it alone. Delete it before committing, or add it to `.gitignore`. My vite on 3007 is stopped.

My screenshots are in `/tmp/claude-1001/-srv-junction-espoo-gemini-4-braincells/8ccf7358-e8c7-41b2-a637-c4fe035c976e/scratchpad/out/`. `desktop-broken.png` and `phone-none.png` show points 1 and 2.

I've restyled the image comparison dialog so it looks like the rest of the site, and the council approved it after three rounds. It isn't committed yet.

![after](/tmp/claude-1001/-srv-junction-espoo-gemini-4-braincells/164d76fc-e50c-47dd-9796-d6d686e923bf/scratchpad/r0/desktop-compare-edited.png)

**Why it looked wrong:** the meme feature had its own mint-green colour scheme that matched nothing else on the site. I moved it onto the site's own colours and styles:
- **Frame:** the dialog is now the site's standard pop-up: near-black, thin border, cut corners, same opening animation.
- **Title:** "EDITED COPY" is in the wide Michroma lettering, with a 2px underline in the painting colour for that kind of match (orange for edited or cropped).
- **Layout switch and labels:** "Side by side" / "Slider overlay" look like the side panel's tabs, and the picture headings use the site's small uppercase mono labels.
- **Boxes:** the edited-region boxes use the same green as the detection boxes on the main canvas. Green now appears only there.
- **Facts:** the grey pills became a labelled grid like the panel's stats row.
- **"What changed":** the list, change chips and the Nemotron caveat now use the panel's existing styles; the caveat sits in a dashed gold box.
- **Rest of the meme feature:** the meme section in the side panel and the meme cards on the canvas also moved off the mint colours.

**Checks:** the type check, the 29 meme checks and the 11 tests pass. Desktop and phone screenshots show no sideways scrolling.

## Council review

Rounds: 3

| Delegate | Round 1 | Round 2 | Round 3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Opus | 8/10 | 8.5/10 | 9/10 |
| GPT Sol | 8.5/10 | 9/10 (approved) | not re-run |
| GPT Astra | 8.5/10 | 9.5/10 | not re-run |

- the close button is back to a finger-sized 44px on phones
- the phone spacing under the title is fixed
- "No longer a match" now gets a neutral underline
- two layout glitches when an image fails to load are fixed

I left out a few optional wording tweaks to keep the change small.

- The dashed lines between variations on the canvas graph are still mint; changing them is one line in `src/engine/graph.ts:983`.
- Opus noted two wording issues in `compare.ts` for later: the "slider alignment" note still shows when there's no slider, and the key always mentions the crop box.

The changes are uncommitted on branch `ui/compare-renaissance` in `/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance`, based on the latest main. I worked from that fresh copy because the shared /srv checkout is out of date and has someone else's uncommitted edits. Changed files:

Fix or dismiss each finding, then open the PR with `entire trail ci-pr`, undraft it with `entire trail ready`, and squash-merge it while keeping the checkpoint trailers in the squash commit:
11-
12-  ```bash
13:  gh pr merge <n> --squash --body "$(git log --format='%(trailers:key=Entire-Checkpoint)' origin/main..HEAD | grep . | sort -u)"
14-  ```
15-
16:  A squash without those trailers loses the link between the commit on `main` and its agent sessions.
17-- Don't run `entire trail rerun-review` or enable project Agents on entire.com: those run paid cloud agents. Ask the repo owner first.
18-- Never paste keys or `.env` contents into a prompt: transcripts are stored in checkpoints.

Reviews are saved as named profiles in Entire settings and clone-local preferences. On first run, guided setup writes a profile and asks before starting agents. Flags: --configure set up a review profile (shows available agents + profiles). With --set-* flags it writes the profile non-interactively; otherwise it opens the wizard (interactive) without starting agents. --set-agents with --configure: comma-separated reviewer agents for the profile --set-judge with --configure: the consolidating judge as agent[=model] --set-output with --configure: where the verdict goes: local (default) or trail --local with --configure: save to .entire/settings.local.json (just you) instead of .entire/settings.json (shared). # claude-code review

The verdict is **approve with nits**: this is a restyle and I found no blocking defect, but it brings in one CSS regression and leaves a few inconsistencies. I read the diff and checked the code it touches, but ran no tests or builds. The tests in scope don't render the compare dialog or `factsHtml`. Every CSS variable, the `pop` keyframes, `icon.close` and the global `button` reset that the new CSS depends on exist in `src/styles.css`.

10 findings, most severe first:

1. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:95`: `.meme-plane h3` is now `display: flex` but still relies on `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis`, and ellipsis does not apply to text inside a flex container.

   Failure scenario: A variant heading such as "Match · some-very-long-subdomain.example.com" used to end in "…". The text now sits in an anonymous flex item, so it is cut off mid-character with no ellipsis. Fix: wrap the text in a span that has the ellipsis rules, or drop `display: flex` and use `line-height: 34px` with `text-align` instead.

2. `web/trackdown/src/ui/compare.ts:118`: `refreshComparison` never clears `data-removed`. If a match comes back after `showRemoved` has replaced the dialog body, it dereferences elements that no longer exist.

   Failure scenario: The server drops a candidate (`showRemoved` replaces `.meme-compare-body`), then a later poll returns it again. `active.dataset.relation` is set, then `renderPictures` runs `querySelector('.meme-upload')!`, gets null and throws a TypeError. That stops the refresh, and `data-removed` keeps `--vc` on the 'unsure' colour. Fix: if `active.dataset.removed` is set, return early (or rebuild the dialog) before touching the regions.

3. `web/trackdown/src/ui/variations.ts:68`: The new style removes the old green (`--meme-green` / `#a2ffb5`) everywhere in meme.css, but the canvas legend and the variant edges in graph.ts still hard-code `#a2ffb5`.

   Failure scenario: The 'Image variation' legend line and the variant edges (`src/engine/graph.ts:983`) are drawn in the old mint `#a2ffb5`. The dialog and the mobile peek now use `--cv` (`#3fe07a`), so the same concept appears in two different greens. Fix: use `var(--cv)` (or a dedicated token) in both places.

4. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:33`: The canvas card highlight covers only `.meme-edited`, while the group border (line 18) and the dialog `--vc` (line 6) now give cropped matches the mutation colour too.

   Failure scenario: A cropped variation shows a mutation-orange group border and an orange dialog accent, but its canvas card has a plain border. Edited cards get the orange border, so cropped and edited look different on the canvas. Fix: `.card:has(.meme-edited), .card:has(.meme-cropped) { ... }`.

5. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:75`: The close button shrank from at least 44x44 to 36x36 for every viewport wider than 600px, including touch tablets.

   Failure scenario: On a 768px tablet the close button is now a 36px target, down from 44px. The 44px size comes back only at 600px and below. Fix: keep `min-width`/`min-height: 44px` (the visual box can stay small with padding), or apply the 44px size under `(pointer: coarse)`.

6. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:130`: The decorative `content: "↺"` on each change item is generated text that screen readers announce.

   Failure scenario: VoiceOver/NVDA read 'anticlockwise open circle arrow' before every change description in the aria-live `.meme-changes` region, so each live update repeats it. Fix: `content: "↺" / "";` (alt-text syntax) or draw it as a background or mask.

7. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:133`: Kind chips now use `white-space: nowrap` inside a dialog with `overflow-x: hidden`, so a long chip label is clipped and can't be read.

   Failure scenario: On a 320px phone, a long `change_kinds` value (e.g. 'text overlay and caption replacement') in uppercase mono with 0.12em letter-spacing is wider than the dialog. The chip is cut off at the dialog edge with no wrap or scroll. Fix: allow wrapping (drop `nowrap` and the fixed `height: 22px`, use `min-height`).

8. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:63`: The cut-corner `clip-path` sits on the scrolling dialog itself, so it clips the 1px border on the diagonals and the top of the vertical scrollbar.

   Failure scenario: When the comparison content is taller than `100dvh - 48px`, the scrollbar's top 18px is cut away at the top-right corner, and the hairline border disappears at both cut corners. The modal looks broken at its corners. Fix: draw the frame on an inner wrapper or pseudo-element, or put the clip on a non-scrolling outer element.

9. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:112`: `rgba(63, 224, 122, …)` is hand-copied from `--cv` three times (scanning, region fill, box-key swatch), even though the same file already uses `color-mix` with a token.

   Failure scenario: If `--cv` changes in styles.css, the detection-box fills, the box-key swatches and the scanning stripe keep the old green. Fix: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--cv) 8%, transparent)`, as `.meme-finding` already does, or add a `--cv-3` token next to `--cv-2`.

10. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:7`: The colour for same/resized relations is a raw `#c9c4bb` rather than a palette token, even though the header comment says the dialog uses only the site's colours.

    Failure scenario: `#c9c4bb` matches no `:root` token (`--text` is `#f2efe9`, `--text-2` is `#b4b0a8`), so this accent won't follow palette changes and adds an untracked colour. Fix: use `var(--text-2)` or add a named token in styles.css.

Reviewing ui/compare-renaissance vs origin/main: 2 commits, 3 files changed, 0 uncommitted Running review with claude-code... # claude-code review I found 6 findings, all low severity. I could not run `tsc` or `scripts/check-meme.mjs` here because both need approval, so none of these has been run. 6 findings, most severe first: 1. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:96`: Adding `isolation: isolate` to the overlay planes traps the upload plane's `h3 { z-index: 2 }` inside its own stacking context, so the later `.meme-variant` plane and its full-width label bar now paint over the 'Submission' label. Failure scenario: In Slider overlay mode, drag the reveal toward 100%. The variant plane, clipped to inset(0 calc(100% - reveal) 0 0), and its h3 bar (now `right: 0`, 0.9-opaque background) cover the right-aligned 'Submission' label until it is hidden completely. Before, the upload plane had no stacking context, so its z-index:2 heading always stayed above the variant plane. Fix: drop `isolation` from `.meme-upload`, or give `.meme-upload h3` a stacking position above `.meme-variant`. 2. `web/trackdown/src/ui/compare.ts:51`: Facts are rendered as `valuelabel` divs, so screen readers read the value before its label, with nothing tying the two together. Failure scenario: A screen reader announces 'Edited Relation, 12 Perceptual distance, #42 Receipt…' with no term/definition semantics. The old flat spans read 'Perceptual distance 12' and 'Receipt #42'. The node panel already renders facts as `
label
value
` (panel.ts:229). Fix: emit dt/dd pairs, or put the label first in the DOM and use CSS order for the visual stacking. 3. `web/trackdown/src/ui/compare.ts:57`: The facts grid assumes a 'Source page' cell is present. When `page_url` is missing or not http(s), the wide 'First seen' cell leaves an empty grid slot on both desktop and phone. Failure scenario: A match with no valid page_url has 6 facts. Desktop row 2 becomes Receipt (col 1) + First seen (cols 2-3), with col 4 empty and the bottom border ending in a hole. On phone (2 columns), Receipt sits alone on row 3 next to an empty cell, because First seen spans `1 / -1` onto its own row. Fix: make `.wide` fill the rest of the row (`grid-column: span 2 / -1` or `auto / -1`), or always render a 'Source page: Not supplied' fact. 4. `web/trackdown/src/ui/compare.ts:118`: The new guard on `dataset.removed` fixes a real crash: after showRemoved wipes the body, a returning match made `renderPictures` dereference a null `.meme-upload`. No test covers it, and check-meme.mjs only exercises data helpers. Failure scenario: A later refactor that reorders or drops line 118 brings back `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null` from `querySelector('.meme-upload')!` whenever a removed candidate reappears in a live update. Nothing in `npm test` or check-meme would catch it. Fix: add a DOM-level check (jsdom or happy-dom) that calls refreshComparison without the match, then with it, and asserts no throw and that the 'No longer a match' title stays. 5. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:73`: The dialog shell copies the site's `.modal` rule (same clip-path polygon, `--ink-bg` background, `--line-2` border, `pop` animation) instead of reusing it. Failure scenario: styles.css:434 `.modal` already defines `clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 18px) 0, 100% 18px, …)`, the background, the border and `animation: pop 0.5s var(--ease-out) both`. Any later change to the site's modal corners or entry animation will silently miss the compare dialog. Fix: add the `modal` class to the dialog and keep only the size and overflow overrides in `.meme-compare`. 6. `web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css:121`: The facts grid duplicates the site's `.stats/.stat` stat-grid rules (styles.css:371-375) with slightly different values. Failure scenario: The `.meme-comparison-facts`/`.meme-fact` border-top/bottom, border-left and first-column padding reset, plus the mono uppercase 10-10.5px label, repeat `.stats`/`.stat`/`.stat .l` by hand, with drift in padding (14px vs 14px 4px 12px 14px) and label size (10px vs 10.5px). Fix: reuse `.stat`/`.l` classes and change only the column count and wrapping. Verdict: approve with nits. No high or medium findings. The one visible regression is the overlay "Submission" label being covered. 1 agent(s) done — 1 succeeded, 0 failed, 0 cancelled claude-code: its permission settings blocked Bash. To allow them, add them to permissions.allow in the reviewer's settings (its review profile config, or ~/.claude/settings.json); update the profile config with entire review --configure general --set-config =.
